visualCharacteristics: Low orange strip (one line on desktop: bold title, text, pill button on the right; stacked on mobile). Invisible and takes no space while empty.
contentPattern: Header row only. No authored content: Adobe Target (at.js VEC activity) injects div.promo-strip__inner with strong (title), span (text) and a.promo-strip__cta (button) into #promo-strip.
usage: Home page, below the main banner (same section): journey-based promotion (signed in: APP Copel; bought Protege Casa: Protege Vida).
reuseGuidance: One per page. Keep the id #promo-strip (VEC selector). For authored promotions use another block: this one is always emptied.
